housing.summary: Numbeo's June 2026 contributor dataset reports C$1,660 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Windsor city centre. Source: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Windsor Ontario limits a monthly rent deposit to one month's rent for the last rental period. Source: https://www.ontario.ca/page/getting-settled-ontario Windsor rental listings are available through Rentals.ca. Source: https://rentals.ca/windsor-on

banking.summary: RBC says newcomers opening an account must be at least 18 and live in Canada, and should have original government-issued identification rather than photocopies, including a passport, driver's licence, PR card or work permit, and SIN. Source: https://www.rbcroyalbank.com/new-to-canada/bank-offers-for-permanent-resident-and-foreign-worker-newcomers/
required_docs: permanent resident card or work permit

schools.summary: Windsor's Assumption College Catholic Middle School offers the International Baccalaureate Middle Years Programme, and Assumption College Catholic High School offers the IB Diploma Programme. Sources: https://www.wecdsb.on.ca/programs/international_baccalaureate/assumption_college_catholic_middle_school https://www.wecdsb.on.ca/programs/international_baccalaureate/assumption_college_catholic_high_school Ontario's official directory lists publicly funded elementary and secondary schools. Source: https://www.ontario.ca/page/list-elementary-and-secondary-schools

legal_admin.summary: For a new permanent resident, IRCC requires a Canadian mailing address and photo within 180 days of receiving PR status so the first PR card can be issued; the address can be given at the port of entry or online. Source: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/permanent-residents/card/apply.html
legal_admin.registration_step: New permanent residents must give Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada a Canadian mailing address and photo within 180 days of receiving permanent resident status to receive their first PR card.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who needs a Social Insurance Number applies through Service Canada online, by mail, or in person; the official application tool identifies the documents required for the applicant's situation. Source: https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/sin/apply.html

transport.summary: Transit Windsor's adult 30-day Smart Pass costs C$124. Source: https://www.citywindsor.ca/residents/transit-windsor/fares A new Ontario resident may use a valid foreign licence for 60 days, then must switch; direct exchange depends on the issuing jurisdiction, while non-reciprocal jurisdictions require tests. Source: https://www.ontario.ca/page/exchange-out-province-drivers-licence Eligible residents register for OHIP in person at ServiceOntario with a completed form and three qualifying documents proving status, Ontario residency, and identity. Source: https://www.ontario.ca/page/apply-ohip-and-get-health-card
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A valid out-of-province or foreign licence may be used for 60 days after moving to Ontario. After that, the resident must switch to an Ontario licence; direct exchange is available only for listed reciprocal jurisdictions, and other jurisdictions require vision, knowledge, and road tests.
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible newcomers must apply for OHIP in person at a ServiceOntario centre with a completed registration form and three qualifying documents: proof of Canadian citizenship or OHIP-eligible immigration status, proof of Ontario residency, and proof of identity.
